runtime_contract.unit_rule: Native extracted pixel dimensions are preserved. Never force these variants into a 32x32 destination.
runtime_contract.physical_props: Place at native size using anchor_mode. Large sprites may visually span multiple authored cells.
runtime_contract.floor_overlays: Center on authored world positions and never own collision.
runtime_contract.collision_rule: collision_profile is a placement hint only. Authored topology/collision remains gameplay authority; never derive collision from sprite alpha.
runtime_contract.family_strategy: Use semantic families with variants, not one Asset V2 family per extracted ID.
runtime_contract.compound_rule: Entries with review_required=true must be manually split or explicitly approved before runtime promotion.
